content.title: Outer-Line Bridge Overtake | Longer Arc for a Half-Car Lead
content.summary: An amber rally car gains half a length through a longer desert outer arc. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: Two distinct vehicles and fixed lane assignments are readable before the curve. + Multiple camera carriers preserve the same relative positions and direction. + Environmental geometry proves which route is longer rather than merely labeling it. + The overtaking gain accumulates continuously in one comparative side view. + The final shared frame measures the new lead while both vehicles remain in motion.
quick_start.recommended_input: Establish two original electric rally cars side by side on a sweeping elevated desert test loop, amber car outside and graphite car inside. Use track markings and the central observation mast to make the amber car's longer outer arc measurable. Hold both cars together when the amber nose reaches half a car length ahead; no cut, collision or unexplained teleport completes the pass.
